quarterly_data.signal: Electronic materials (annual report): with downstream demand recovering and fast demand growth from automotive electronics and AI servers, MLCC dielectric powder sales volume grew steadily with notable high-end breakthroughs. The company focused on AI-server and automotive-grade MLCC dielectric powders, developing and validating products and pushing capacity expansion; some new products made breakthrough progress at core customers, and the supply volume and share of new products kept rising. Its MLCC electronic paste business grew sales rapidly, co-developing high-capacitance, automotive-grade and RF pastes with customers; a full-range ruthenium resistor paste passed offline validation at a domestic customer.

Precision ceramics and fillers (annual report): subsidiary Guoci Saichuang's LED substrates are in stable volume supply to global leading companies; its RF microsystem chip packages (ceramic packages) have become a mainstream packaging solution for low-earth-orbit satellite RF chips with fast sales growth (company claim); it is developing laser heat sinks, microwave capacitors, ferrite magnetic devices and ceramic substrates for optical modules. Copper-clad-laminate fillers (low-loss spherical silica for high-frequency high-speed CCL): some products achieved key technical breakthroughs, a mass-production line is being built, validation at several leading customers accelerated and small-batch sales began; the high-frequency high-speed CCL spherical silica R&D project passed validation at some customers with capacity construction and mass-production introduction under way.

Major projects at year-end: ceramic circuit board project plant No. 2 RMB 59,378,218.03; East China precision ceramics project phase 1 plant RMB 51,348,117.24; plant for the 60,000-tonne-a-year high-end organic composite coating materials project RMB 34,811,069.13 (no budget or completion date stated). Investment in the year RMB 598,789,216.34, up 31.92%.

2026 business plan (annual report, company guidance): the company will prioritise funding and talent for strategic new products in AI compute, solid-state batteries, commercial aerospace and embodied intelligence. Key 2026 projects: (1) MLCC powders focused on AI servers and automotive, continuing product development and capacity expansion; (2) high-frequency high-speed CCL fillers, striving for breakthroughs and batch supply of high-end products at key customers; (3) sulfide solid electrolyte, working with key customers on industrialisation; (4) zirconia and titania dispersions, extending to higher-end products; (5) multilayer ceramic substrates for data centers, accelerating development and validation; (6) ceramic packages for commercial aerospace, striving for fast growth in output and sales. It also plans to push the Australian SDI (dental) project.
